confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Athens pricing for July peak season. No live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident; accommodation and bar prices are less certain and peak-season rates vary widely. FX provenance is weaker: the 0.6955 figure comes from search-result summary text attributing it to the RBA overview page, which I did not open. A second search could not corroborate it, so treat the FX observation as unverified until checked against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Athens pricing relative to other southern European capitals with comparable summer tourism demand, with Athens restaurant prices set somewhat below Western European capitals. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors were set with reference to the local relationship between restaurant drink prices and cafe and meal prices.
